history.evidence_level: C: Medlock-derived starting value tested on the reconstructed morphology
history.reason: Starting value produced Rin below the 100 MOhm lower gate while RMP and tau passed.

history.evidence_level: D: bounded fit proposal requiring validation
history.reason: Reduce leak alone to raise Rin above 100 MOhm while retaining predicted tau below 30 ms.

history.evidence_level: D: bounded leak-only fit proposal requiring validation
history.reason: One small refinement from 3e-5 to cross the 100 MOhm lower gate while keeping predicted tau below 30 ms.

fitting.rule: Fit passive behavior only. Keep Ra and cm at their supported values unless new evidence requires a change, then recalculate nseg.

identity_statement: The L292-E1-LCN reconstruction is a rat lamina-I local-circuit morphological scaffold. ePKCgamma/eVGLUT3/eDOR/eSST/eCR/eTrC labels refer to computational Medlock population identity and are not molecular identities experimentally confirmed for L292-E1-LCN.

numerical_convergence.criterion_note: D: project numerical acceptance proposal, not an experimental target

protocol.range_reason: Small hyperpolarizing steps for linear subthreshold passive measurements plus a zero-current stability trace.

validation_targets.post_step_recovery_tolerance_note: D: project numerical acceptance proposal; not an experimental target
